changes.title: Thaer leaves
changes.before: "Get some rest. There are things I have to see to, and I'll be back as soon as I'm able."
changes.after: "I need to speak to Leorin. Try to rest, Seralune. I'll be back as soon as I can."
changes.why: Naming Leorin gives his leaving a reason, and it sets up Leorin at the door later.
changes.decision_note: Your edit, from the Word file of 1 October.

changes.title: Waiting
changes.before: Seralune couldn't keep still. She walked from the fire to the window and back again, and her legs still shook, and she walked anyway.
changes.after: Seralune couldn't keep still. She walked from the fire to the window and back again, listening for Thaer's footsteps.
changes.why: "Listening for Thaer's footsteps" leads straight into the voices outside.
changes.decision_note: Your edit, from the Word file of 1 October.

changes.title: The tray
changes.before: His eyes went to the tray on the table. "You haven't eaten."
changes.after: His eyes went to the tray on the table. "Please, Seralune. Eat something."
changes.why: He still won't answer, but now he asks her for something, and that's harder to fight.
changes.decision_note: Your edit, from the Word file of 1 October.

changes.title: "You look exactly as you did this morning"
changes.before: "Leorin's an old man, Thaer. What happened while I was in that room?"
changes.after: "Thaer, look at me. Leorin's an old man. You look exactly as you did this morning. What happened while I was in there?"
changes.why: Good: she puts the evidence to him out loud, the way she reasons, and still doesn't say "years".
